Name: mgn7h_rail_width
Comment: MGN7H linear rail nominal width. Lightweight option for low-mass toolheads.

Name: mgn9h_rail_width
Comment: MGN9H rail nominal width.

Name: mgn12h_rail_width
Comment: MGN12H rail nominal width. Standard on V-Core 3.1 AWD Y and Z.

Name: mgn15h_rail_width
Comment: MGN15H rail nominal width. Heavy-duty gantry / Z axes.

Name: mgn12h_carriage_length
Comment: MGN12H H-type carriage block length. Used for toolhead plate sizing and hole pattern layout.

Name: mgn12h_pitch_along
Comment: MGN12H carriage mounting hole pitch — along rail axis.

Name: mgn12h_pitch_across
Comment: MGN12H carriage mounting hole pitch — perpendicular to rail axis.

Name: mgn9h_pitch_along
Comment: MGN9H carriage mounting hole pitch along rail.

Name: mgn9h_pitch_across
Comment: MGN9H carriage mounting hole pitch across rail.

Name: gt2_belt_pitch
Comment: GT2 / 3MGT belt tooth pitch. Standard for K3, V-Core, Voron.

Name: gt2_belt_width
Comment: GT2 / 3MGT belt nominal width.

Name: gt2_clamp_extra
Comment: Extra width in belt clamp slot for insertion and tensioning clearance.

Name: gt2_pulley_16t_od
Comment: GT2 16-tooth pulley OD (approximate). Verify per brand — varies ±0.3 mm.

Name: gt2_pulley_20t_od
Comment: GT2 20-tooth pulley OD (approximate). Most common idler/drive pulley size.

Name: gt2_pulley_80t_od
Comment: GT2 80-tooth pulley OD. Used in some AWD / geared arrangements.

Name: gt2_pulley_bore
Comment: Standard GT2 pulley shaft bore — 5 mm. Add 0.05 mm clearance for FDM shaft receivers.

Name: f695_bearing_od
Comment: F695 flanged bearing OD — standard GT2 idler bearing in Voron/K3/V-Core.

Name: f695_bearing_id
Comment: F695 bearing ID — fits M5 shoulder bolt.

Name: f695_bearing_width
Comment: F695 bearing width.

Name: nema17_body_width
Comment: NEMA17 motor body width (square). Standard across all NEMA17 motors.

Name: nema17_bolt_pattern_center_to_center
Comment: NEMA17 mounting bolt pattern — center to center (square pattern).

Name: nema17_bolt_size
Comment: NEMA17 mounting bolt — M3. Model clearance holes at hole_geometry_m3_screw_clearance_diameter.

Name: nema17_shaft_diameter
Comment: NEMA17 output shaft diameter. Standard 5 mm.

Name: nema17_shaft_flat_depth
Comment: NEMA17 shaft D-flat depth. Used for set screw / grub screw engagement geometry.

Name: nema17_shaft_length_standard
Comment: NEMA17 standard shaft length — 20 mm. Some variants: 22, 24 mm. Verify your specific motor.

Name: nema17_face_boss_diameter
Comment: NEMA17 front face centering boss diameter. Used for precision motor registration in mounts.

Name: nema14_body_width
Comment: NEMA14 motor body width — used in compact extruder motors (Orbiter, Sherpa Mini).

Name: nema14_bolt_pattern_center_to_center
Comment: NEMA14 mounting bolt pattern C-C.

Name: nema14_shaft_diameter
Comment: NEMA14 output shaft diameter.

Name: vslot_2020_extrusion_width
Comment: 2020 V-slot extrusion nominal width.

Name: vslot_2040_extrusion_width
Comment: 2040 extrusion nominal width.

Name: tslot_m3_nut_slot_clearance_width
Comment: M3 T-slot nut / hammerhead sliding width in 2020 extrusion. ISO slot = 5.50 + 0.20 mm clearance.

Name: beacon_probe_body_outer_diameter
Comment: Beacon eddy-current probe body OD. Used for mount bore and retention clip geometry.

Name: beacon_probe_body_total_length
Comment: Beacon probe body total length. Verify against your Beacon revision.

Name: orbiter_v25_motor_mount_bolt_pattern
Comment: Orbiter v2.5 extruder mounting bolt pattern C-C (NEMA14 pattern).

Name: orbiter_v25_filament_path_offset_from_mount
Comment: Orbiter v2.5 filament centerline offset from mount face. Used for toolhead geometry validation.

Name: chube_hotend_collet_outer_diameter
Comment: Chube Conduction hotend collet OD. Used for retention clip bore and mount pocket. Verify with your unit.

Name: canbus_cable_chain_slot_width
Comment: CAN bus toolhead umbilical cable chain slot minimum width. Accounts for cable bundle + connector bodies.

Name: toolhead_plate_5mm
Comment: V-Core toolhead carriage CNC plate thickness — 5 mm 6061-T6 as used in Wishbone toolhead architecture.

Name: toolhead_plate_4mm
Comment: K3 / secondary toolhead plate thickness — 4 mm 6061-T6.

Name: cnc_plate_tolerance
Comment: Mill tolerance on 6061-T6 stock plate thickness — typically ±0.05–0.10 mm. Account for this in stack height calculations when combining printed and machined parts.

Name: cnc_drilled_oversize
Comment: Drilled hole tolerance in aluminum — typically +0.05/−0.00 mm. For precision fits, always ream to H7 class after drilling.

Name: cnc_h7_ream_tol
Comment: H7 reamed hole tolerance for a 5 mm hole — ±0.006 mm. Reference for press-fit dowel pins and bearing seats in 6061.

Name: cnc_m2_tap_drill
Comment: M2×0.4 tap drill diameter in aluminum — ISO standard pre-tap hole for ~75% thread engagement.

Name: cnc_m2p5_tap_drill
Comment: M2.5×0.45 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_m3_tap_drill
Comment: M3×0.5 tap drill diameter in aluminum — standard for all M3 tapped holes in 6061 toolhead plates.

Name: cnc_m4_tap_drill
Comment: M4×0.7 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_m5_tap_drill
Comment: M5×0.8 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_m6_tap_drill
Comment: M6×1.0 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_thread_engage_min_ratio
Comment: Minimum thread engagement length = bolt_diameter × this ratio. M3 in 4 mm plate = 4.0 mm engagement > 1.5× = OK. Below 1× risks strip-out under load.

Name: cnc_thread_engage_rec_ratio
Comment: Recommended thread engagement for structural joints = 2× bolt diameter. M3 structural: 6 mm minimum engagement.

Name: cnc_min_wall_tap
Comment: Minimum material wall thickness surrounding a tapped hole in aluminum. Thinner risks thread pullout and wall blowout.

Name: cnc_m3_csink_4mm
Comment: Countersink depth for a flush M3 flat-head screw in a 4 mm plate. ISO M3 flat head height = 1.70 mm.

Name: cnc_m3_csink_5mm
Comment: Same countersink depth for 5 mm plate — flat head fully recessed with 3.30 mm of uncut material remaining.

Name: cnc_pocket_depth_tol
Comment: Typical pocket depth tolerance achievable from most CNC services — ±0.05 mm. Tighter than this requires premium machining.

Name: cnc_5mm_press_fit_pin
Comment: 5 mm H7 press-fit dowel hole in 6061 — nominal 5.000 mm −0.006 mm = 4.994 mm lower bound. Requires reaming.

Name: cnc_thermal_expansion
Comment: 6061-T6 linear thermal expansion coefficient — ~23.6 µm/m/°C ≈ 0.08 µm/mm/°C. Relevant for chamber-heated assemblies where aluminum and plastic expand at different rates.

Name: cnc_em_6mm_dia
Comment: 6mm single-flute roughing endmill diameter. Primary roughing tool for Carvera Air aluminum work.

Name: cnc_em_6mm_corner_r
Comment: Corner radius on 6mm endmill — not truly sharp. Design internal corners with at least this radius.

Name: cnc_em_3175_dia
Comment: 1/8 inch single-flute finishing endmill diameter. Primary finishing tool.

Name: cnc_em_3175_corner_r
Comment: Corner radius on 1/8 inch endmill.

Name: cnc_em_2mm_dia
Comment: 2mm ball endmill diameter. For filament half-bores and small radii.

Name: cnc_min_internal_r
Comment: Minimum internal corner radius for finish-machined pockets. Equals finishing endmill radius (3.175/2).

Name: cnc_min_internal_r_rough
Comment: Minimum internal corner radius for roughing-only pockets. Equals roughing endmill radius (6.0/2) + clearance.

Name: cnc_max_doc
Comment: Maximum axial depth of cut per pass in aluminum on Carvera Air 200W spindle.

Name: cnc_max_stepover_pct
Comment: Maximum radial stepover as percentage of tool diameter for roughing in aluminum.

Name: cnc_stock_to_leave
Comment: Radial stock-to-leave for finish passes. Removed by finishing endmill in a separate pass.

Name: cnc_stock_to_leave_z
Comment: Axial (floor) stock-to-leave for finish passes.

Name: cnc_max_pocket_depth_ratio
Comment: Maximum pocket depth as multiple of tool diameter. Beyond this deflection and chip evacuation degrade.

Name: cnc_vise_grip_min
Comment: Minimum material height below vise jaw tops for secure clamping. Less risks part pulling out.

Name: cnc_tab_height
Comment: Holding tab height (floor-referenced) for full-depth cutout contours. REAL-CUT 2026-06-22: 0.8mm snapped on a ~9.5mm Al cutout and the freed part wrecked the cut edge (scrapped). ~0.3mm is breakthrough below the part so real holding material is ~1.2mm. Saw/file off; do not hand-snap.

Name: cnc_tab_width
Comment: Holding tab width along the contour. >=5mm for full-depth Al cutouts (3mm tore out 2026-06-22). Sturdy enough to saw rather than hand-snap.

Name: cnc_tab_count_min
Comment: Minimum holding tabs per full-depth cutout contour. Place at well-supported edge midpoints; more tabs beat fewer.

Name: cnc_blank_oversize
Comment: Blank oversize per side beyond finished part envelope. Provides clamping and datum material.

Name: cnc_datum_face_depth
Comment: Facing depth to establish datum surface on raw stock. Removes mill marks and creates a flat reference.

Name: cnc_work_area_x
Comment: Carvera Air maximum X travel.

Name: cnc_work_area_y
Comment: Carvera Air maximum Y travel.

Name: cnc_reprobe_tol
Comment: Expected accuracy of Z re-probe after part flip. Budget this into through-feature meet-in-middle tolerances.

Name: cnc_slip_fit
Comment: CNC slip fit clearance per side (H7/h6 class). Part slides freely with no perceptible play.

Name: cnc_press_fit
Comment: CNC press fit interference per side (H7/p6 class). Requires arbor press. For dowel pins and bearing seats.

Name: cnc_transition_fit
Comment: CNC transition fit (H7/k6 class). May or may not need light force to assemble.

Name: cnc_surface_ra_rough
Comment: Surface roughness Ra in micrometers achievable after roughing passes on Carvera Air.

Name: cnc_surface_ra_finish
Comment: Surface roughness Ra in micrometers after finishing passes.

Name: cnc_surface_ra_face
Comment: Surface roughness Ra in micrometers after face milling.

Name: cnc_edge_break
Comment: Standard edge break chamfer for deburring. Apply to all sharp external edges after machining.

Name: cnc_thread_relief_dia
Comment: Thread relief undercut — add this to tap drill diameter for the relief groove.

Name: cnc_thread_relief_depth
Comment: Thread relief undercut depth below last thread. 1.5-2x thread pitch.

Name: alu_6061_service_max
Comment: 6061-T6 maximum continuous service temperature in degrees C before age-hardening degrades.

Name: alu_6061_density
Comment: 6061-T6 density in g/cm3. For weight estimation.

Name: cnc_m8_tap_drill
Comment: M8x1.25 tap drill diameter in aluminum (75% thread). Source: ISO 261

Name: cnc_m10_tap_drill
Comment: M10x1.5 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: cnc_m12_tap_drill
Comment: M12x1.75 tap drill diameter in aluminum.

Name: bearing_608_id
Comment: 608 bearing bore (skate bearing; filament rollers, idlers).

Name: bearing_608_od
Comment: 608 bearing OD.

Name: bearing_608_width
Comment: 608 bearing width.

Name: bearing_625_id
Comment: 625 bearing bore (common idler).

Name: bearing_625_od
Comment: 625 bearing OD.

Name: bearing_625_width
Comment: 625 bearing width.

Name: bearing_623_id
Comment: 623 bearing bore (small idler; F623 flanged variant common).

Name: bearing_623_od
Comment: 623 bearing OD.

Name: bearing_623_width
Comment: 623 bearing width.

Name: bearing_688_id
Comment: 688 bearing bore (compact idler).

Name: bearing_688_od
Comment: 688 bearing OD.

Name: bearing_688_width
Comment: 688 bearing width.

Name: bearing_6802_id
Comment: 6802 thin-section bearing bore.

Name: bearing_6802_od
Comment: 6802 bearing OD.

Name: bearing_6802_width
Comment: 6802 bearing width.

Name: bearing_mr105_id
Comment: MR105 mini bearing bore.

Name: bearing_mr105_od
Comment: MR105 bearing OD.

Name: bearing_mr105_width
Comment: MR105 bearing width.

Name: vslot_2020_slot_width
Comment: 20-series T-slot/V-slot opening; M5 bolt / 6 mm T-nut. V-slot opening ~6.2 mm. Source: wellste

Name: vslot_3030_extrusion_width
Comment: 3030 extrusion nominal width.

Name: vslot_3030_slot_width
Comment: 3030 slot width (often 8.2); M6 bolt. Some 3030 are 6 mm slot - verify.

Name: vslot_4040_extrusion_width
Comment: 4040 extrusion nominal width.

Name: vslot_4040_slot_width
Comment: 4040 slot width; M8 bolt. Some makers do 10 mm slot - verify.

Name: gear_pressure_angle
Comment: Involute pressure angle for FDM/industry gears. 20 deg = stronger teeth, tolerant of center-distance error; 14.5 deg is legacy. Source: AGMA/ISO.

Name: gear_module_fine
Comment: Fine gear module (small toys/mechanisms). Pitch dia = module x teeth. Two-gear center distance (the 'spacing') = module x (z1+z2)/2. Source: meta-matic/EngineerDog.

Name: gear_module_standard
Comment: General-purpose FDM gear module (robots, DIY, fidget gear stacks).

Name: gear_module_coarse
Comment: Coarse module for higher-torque / robust FDM gears.

Name: gear_backlash
Comment: Total backlash between two meshing FDM gears printed SEPARATELY (~0.15 mm/gear). Apply as tooth thinning or +center distance; tune to printer. Source: FDM gear guides.

Name: gear_pip_clearance
Comment: Per-surface clearance for PRINT-IN-PLACE gears (planetary fidgets) at 0.2 mm layer / 0.4 mm nozzle. ~0.1-0.2: tighter binds, looser rattles. Source: Printables PIP-fidget makers.

Name: gear_addendum_factor
Comment: Addendum (tooth height above pitch circle) = this x module. ISO standard 1.0. Dimensionless.

Name: gear_dedendum_factor
Comment: Dedendum (depth below pitch circle) = this x module; includes root clearance. Dimensionless.

Name: gear_tip_clearance_factor
Comment: Tip-to-root clearance = this x module. Whole tooth depth = (addendum+dedendum) = 2.25 x module. Dimensionless.

Name: gear_min_teeth
Comment: Min teeth to avoid undercut on FDM 20 deg gears (theoretical 17; 12-14 OK printed, profile-shift below ~17). Dimensionless count.

Name: bearing_r188_id
Comment: R188 bearing bore (1/4 in). Compact fidget-spinner bearing vs the larger 608.

Name: bearing_r188_od
Comment: R188 bearing OD (1/2 in). Source: Boca Bearings fidget guide.

Name: bearing_r188_width
Comment: R188 bearing width (3/16 in). Verify - some R188 ship 1/8 in (3.18 mm) wide.
